newsitem.title: LATVIA: PAREKS CONFIRMS KURSK DEAL, EYES UNIBANKA GDRS.
newsitem.headline: PAREKS CONFIRMS KURSK DEAL, EYES UNIBANKA GDRS.

text.p: Leading bank Pareks Banka on Thursday confirmed it is to arrange financial services and a 130 billion rouble loan for Russia's Kursk region and said it would take part in the issue of GDRs for rival Unibanka .

"The bank has undertaken to grant a loan for a total amount of 130 billion roubles (about $25 million) as well as to assist in the emission and placement of municipal bonds and in producing an international credit rating for the region," Pareks said in a statement.
It said it has transferred an initial tranche of 65 billion this week. The aim of the tranche is to buy 200 grain harvesters from the Rostelmash factory. The repayment period is six months.

Pareks said the financing of the Kursk region was the bank's third major project after arranging a 12 million lats loan to Lattelekom and completing the primary placement of muni bonds for Odessa worth 30 million hryvnias.
Pareks also said that in the near future it intended to take part in the issue of global depository receipts (GDRs) by Unibanka.
